purpose_zh: 把待确认的责任主体变成一条可审计的启动程序：先冻结范围和资料，再进行资格与利益冲突审查、公开异议、授权留痕和版本交接；本包不指定机构、运营者或批准结论。
purpose_en: Turns an unconfirmed accountable party into an auditable startup procedure: freeze scope and evidence first, then review eligibility and conflicts, publish objections, record authorization, and hand over a versioned record. This package names no institution, operator, or approval outcome.

claim_boundary.boundary_zh: 这是授权前的制度接口，不是委任、审批、保险、预算、招标或现场运行证明；概念空间锚点不能代替现场地点。
claim_boundary.boundary_en: This is a pre-authorization governance interface, not evidence of appointment, approval, insurance, budget, procurement, or field operation; conceptual anchors are not field locations.

principles.rule_zh: 没有可追溯责任角色、替补角色、申诉入口和停止权，不得进入测试或扩展。
principles.rule_en: Without a traceable accountable role, backup role, appeal route, and stop authority, no test or expansion may start.

principles.rule_zh: 本包只描述确认程序和所需证据，不把角色类别写成已确认主体。
principles.rule_en: This package describes a confirmation procedure and required evidence; role classes are never presented as confirmed entities.

principles.name_en: Objections stay visible and versions can roll back
principles.rule_zh: 公开异议、利益冲突、未解决问题和撤回原因必须进入 release note；无法复核时保持 hold。
principles.rule_en: Public objections, conflicts, unresolved issues, and withdrawal reasons enter the release note; unverifiable evidence keeps the release on hold.

initiator_role_classes: 依法授权的公共管理角色
stages.public_channel: 可访问的公告、人工/电话/纸面入口和版本编号
候选资格、回避事项和异议入口公开可查

stages.name_zh: 公示、人工反馈与异议期
stages.name_en: Publish, provide human feedback, and receive objections
stages.public_channel: 保留人工、电话、纸面或现场替代，不以数字账号作为唯一入口
只有授权记录、范围、期限和退出条件齐全后，状态才可由 hold 进入 authorized；本包不执行此转换
公开新增、变更、暂停、撤回、异议答复和资料删除证明

role_selection_rules.reject_if: only a title, logo, AI agent, or submitter statement is supplied
the candidate reviews its own incident or its own public objection without an independent route

role_selection_rules.name_en: Takeover and appeal run in parallel
role_selection_rules.reject_if: a digital account, model output, or automated channel is the only way to stop or appeal
the record has no end date, review point, or withdrawal evidence

no_go_conditions: authorization record is missing or outside its declared scope
conflict disclosure, insurance requirement, incident route, or independent review is missing
human, telephone, paper, or on-site alternative is unavailable
public objection, deletion proof, or rollback decision cannot be replayed
